experiment_name: V9: Targeted Localization + Multi-Candidate Fusion + Generalization + Calibration

phases.scope: Audit checkpoints, verify splits, initialize directory structure, benchmark hardware.

phases.phase_name: Phase 1: Multi-Source Proposal Generation & Label-Free Ranking
phases.scope: Evaluate multi-resolution (512, 768), high-res details, calcification pathway, multi-feature label-free ranking (contrast, area, eccentricity, compactness, boundary distance). Target: Recall@5 IoU>=0.30.

phases.phase_name: Phase 2: Multi-Candidate Vision Transformer Fusion (Arms A-G)
phases.scope: Shared ViT backbone with candidate attention / gated pooling (K=1, 3, 5), full mammogram feature, and dedicated calcification pathway. Select by Validation Macro-F1.
Controlled train-only augmentations (spatial, intensity, resolution), hard-example weighting, and multi-scale consistency loss to bridge the validation-test generalization gap.
Fit temperature scaling (logits / T) on validation data only. Freeze T before test evaluation. Compute validation Brier and ECE.

phases.phase_name: Phase 5: Single Locked Final Test Evaluation
phases.scope: Single locked evaluation on 525 primary / 526 comprehensive test cohort with frozen parameters and fixed threshold 0.50.
